configurations.name: rate-demo
runtimeArgs: D=$(mktemp -d) && echo "demo dir: $D" && PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m lofi_rl.ui.manifest demo "$D/inbox/2026-11-03/demo-bws4" --mode bws4 && LOFI_VOTES="$D/votes" PYTHONPATH=src exec .venv/bin/python -m lofi_rl.ui.serve "$D/inbox/2026-11-03/demo-bws4" --no-browser --port 8596

configurations.name: rate-batch-check
runtimeArgs: B=${CHECK_BATCH:-$(cat .claude/check-batch.txt 2>/dev/null || echo inbox/2026-11-03/b1103-1-keys)}; D=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$D/inbox/$(basename $(dirname $B))" && cp -R "$B" "$D/inbox/$(basename $(dirname $B))/" && echo "check dir: $D" && LOFI_VOTES="$D/votes" PYTHONPATH=src exec .venv/bin/python -m lofi_rl.ui.serve "$D/inbox/$(basename $(dirname $B))/$(basename $B)" --no-browser --port 8597
